newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 1.47 mln tonnes in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abiove soybean crush 1.47 mln tonnes in Oct.

text.p: Brazilian firms contributing data to the Brazilian Vegetable Oils Industries Association (ABIOVE) crushed 1.47 million tonnes of soybeans in October, down from 1.8 million in September, ABIOVE said.
Total crushings in the first nine months of the marketing year (February/January) now reached 15.66 million tonnes.
ABIOVE estimates the data it receives represents between 90 and 93 percent of total Brazilian crushings.
As well as using domestic soybeans, Brazil imported a total of 788,000 tonnes between February and October, Abiove said.
The October figure left industry stocks at 2.22 million tonnes, down from 3.11 million at the end of September.
Crushings last year in October when contributing companies represented 100 percent of the sector reached 1.89 million tonnes, according to ABIOVE statistics.
Stocks at the end of the month in 1995 reached 3.03 million tonnes.
